pages.text: Repeat the child action at the specified tick interval, optionally exposing the iteration index.

pages.title: Default Mana Cost
pages.text: Add the body costs for every actual repetition. Loops do not discount damage or materials.$(br2)See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l) for the calculation rules.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: 0.35 + L(n)*C + H(T), for total delay span T. While loops also add 0.1 and the condition structure.$(br2)Combine complexity, then apply 5+10*C+0.625*C^2 for total focus. See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l).
